sql: SELECT ot.type_id, count(*) FROM (SELECT o.id FROM objects o WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.id IN (WITH RECURSIVE below(id) AS (SELECT id FROM objects WHERE parent_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM objects c JOIN below ON c.parent_id = below.id) SELECT id FROM below) AND json_extract(o.props_json, ?) = ?) q JOIN object_types ot ON ot.object_id = q.id GROUP BY ot.type_id ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 50
